full_prompt_en: A square folk-art mixed-media image places two elongated female faces among a densely packed field of jewel-colored ornament. The nearer face at right is pale cream with a long straight nose, almond-shaped eye, and small red lips. A second face behind her looks left from beneath a geometric headdress of circles and stripes. Their hair and headwear merge into repeating shapes in turquoise, magenta, orange, gold, teal, and black. Small circular disks, leaf-like motifs, spirals, and grid patterns fill nearly every area of the background. The figures are not set in a believable room; they become part of the decorative surface. Raised-looking lines, tiny dots, and granular patches give the image a mosaic or embroidered texture. Dark outlines keep the faces readable despite the surrounding color density. Light is essentially even and frontal, with pale facial planes separated by value rather than by cast shadow. The larger shapes create a vertical rhythm from the patterned crowns down to the necks and shoulders, while smaller marks keep the eye moving. The palette is saturated but carefully organized, with cream skin giving a place to rest. The overall image feels celebratory, intricate, and handmade, joining human expression to a richly symbolic ornamental world.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形民间艺术混合媒介图像把两张拉长的女子面孔置于宝石色纹饰密集的底层。右边较近面孔是浅奶油色，长直鼻、杏眼与小红唇。身后另一张脸从圆与条纹组成的几何头饰下向左看。头发与头饰融入青绿、洋红、橙、金、蓝绿和黑的重复形。小圆盘、叶状纹、旋纹和格状图案几乎填满背景每处。人物不在可信房间里，而成为装饰表面的一部分。似凸起的线、细点和颗粒色片使图像有马赛克或刺绣肌理。深轮廓让脸在周围色彩密度中仍可读。光大体均匀正面，以明暗值而非投影分开浅脸平面。大形从花纹冠向颈肩建立竖向节奏，小笔点则让视线持续游动。色彩饱和但组织谨慎，奶油肤色提供休息处。整体欢庆、繁复而手工，把人物表情接入丰富象征装饰世界。
style_prompt_en: Folk-art mixed media fills the square with jewel-toned geometric and organic ornament. Turquoise, magenta, orange, gold, black, and cream are separated by dark outlines and tiny raised-looking marks. Flat pale focal areas remain readable amid dense circles, leaves, grids, and spirals. Light is even and frontal, with value contrast replacing cast shadow. Repetition creates a textile or mosaic rhythm; granular dots and irregular edges preserve handmade character. The space stays shallow and decorative. The overall result is celebratory, intricate, and vividly tactile.
style_prompt_zh: 民间艺术混合媒介以宝石色几何与有机纹饰填满方幅。青绿、洋红、橙、金、黑和奶油色由深轮廓与微小似凸起笔痕分开。平坦浅色焦点在浓密圆、叶、格与旋纹中保持可读。光均匀正面，明暗值替代投影。重复形成织物或马赛克节奏；颗粒小点和不规则边缘保留手工性。空间浅而装饰化。整体欢庆、繁密且鲜活可触。
theme_en: Two stylized faces amid dense jewel-colored ornament
theme_zh: 两张风格化面孔与浓密宝石色纹饰
name: Sandra Silberzweig
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
